requirement: CI recognizes earlier PRs contained in later successful target deployments

oracle.invariant: A later successful app and dsh deployment containing the merge commit supersedes an old image failure. An unrelated commit, another environment, open PR or missing merge SHA cannot establish Live. Failed, skipped, partial or inaccessible evidence preserves the previous observation. Old PRs outside bounded history require explicit ancestor comparisons; repeated reads warm remaining PRs without repeating cached evidence. List and detail share coverage, deployment links and the target deployment completion used by the Live time column.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
